assessment.headline: DAY 33. Trump claims Iran asked for ceasefire. Will address nation tonight. But Iran struck a tanker DURING the announcement.
assessment.body:
The most significant 24 hours of the war are unfolding. Trump claims Iran's president asked for a ceasefire and says he'll 'consider when Hormuz is open.' He will address the nation tonight at 9 PM ET (April 2, 6:30 AM IST). Markets rallied sharply — Sensex +1,100, Kospi +8.1%, S&P 500 best day in a year.

But Iran struck an oil tanker off Qatar's coast DURING the ceasefire announcement. FM Araghchi says he has 'no faith in talks' and Iran is prepared for 6+ months. The IRGC's tech company threat deadline has passed. 16 were wounded in Israel including an 11-year-old girl in critical condition.

The contradiction is stark: Trump says ceasefire. Iran says 6 months. The market chose to believe Trump — for now. Tonight's address could go either way.

For India — verified facts (Day 33, 7 PM):
• Sensex ~73,100 (+1,100 close). Nifty ~22,680. Rupee ~94.70
• BW Elm arrives Mangalore today. 8 carriers crossed. 18+485 remain
• Nayara Energy hiked petrol ₹5.30, diesel ₹3 — private pumps rising
• India's March economic review: 'double squeeze — no crude in, no product out'
• Rystad: 500M barrels lost globally. System 'buffered to fragile'
• FII $12.3B outflow March. ₹44L+ Cr destroyed
• Hormuz: 1 ship paid $2 million for Iran's Larak channel

Trump's address tonight is the most important event for India's energy security since the war began. If he announces a withdrawal timeline: relief rally, Brent drops to $85-90, rupee recovers. If he announces escalation (Kharg raid, more troops): Brent spikes past $120, rupee past 96, India enters full crisis mode. Set your alarm for 6:30 AM IST tomorrow.
